description: Traffic Signal Audits is a dataset listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. This dataset describes planned and completed traffic signal audits across the City of Mesa managed transportation system. A traffic signal audit is a formal examination of the number of signalized intersections maintained by the City of Mesa. They are checked for proper programming and operation on a quarterly basis by a formal internal team. Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are its, transportation. The table has 21 columns. Attribution on the portal: Transportation. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
